title: Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space
abstract: arXiv:2609.34181v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. translated_title: 通过潜在空间中的约束优化实现高效推理
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRMs）已展现出卓越的推理能力，但仍然存在“过度思考”的问题，即生成冗余的推理步骤，导致大量的token消耗。现有方法（如抑制反思性关键词或强制缩短推理长度）试图缓解这一问题，但不可避免地会截断必要的推理步骤并引发“思考不足”，从而损害模型性能。为解决这一困境，我们研究了潜在表示，观察到高效的推理步骤在潜在空间中会自然聚类到一个集中的区域，而偏离该区域的步骤往往会产生冗长的序列。为了利用这一发现，我们通过一个二次规划将偏离的隐藏状态投影回该区域，使推理过程保持聚焦于该区域内。随后，我们提出了一种新颖的无需训练的框架来实现高效推理，在不牺牲性能的前提下降低了token生成成本。
tldr: 该论文发现高效推理步骤在潜在空间中会自然聚类到一个集中区域，并提出一种无需训练的约束优化框架，通过二次规划将偏离的隐藏状态投影回该区域，从而在不牺牲性能的前提下减少大型推理模型的冗余token生成。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, and proposes a training-free constrained optimization framework that projects deviating hidden states back into this region via quadratic programming, thereby reducing redundant token generation in Large Reasoning Models without sacrificing performance.
